name: Sabores Peruvian Lomo Saltado Beef Tenderloin & White Rice (No Onion/Pepper Mod)
whyItWorks: Sabores' signature Peruvian stir-fry uses ultra-tender strips of beef tenderloin served with steamed white jasmine rice and potato fries—naturally dairy-free and very easy to digest when you leave the red onions and tomatoes behind.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Lomo Saltado with steamed white rice, asking to hold the stir-fried red onions, bell peppers, and tomatoes (or push them aside and eat only the beef tenderloin and white rice).
watchOuts: Standard stir-fry includes thick-cut red onions and tomatoes—eat only the beef tenderloin strips and white rice during sensitive periods
